== Notes ==
* Up to 37 can be earned per day from completing all zones and events:
** 18 from [[Tribulation Mode]]: 2 per World 1 zone, 4 per World 2 zone.
** 16 from normal mode: 2 from each of the 8 [[Super_Adventure_Box#Worlds_and_zones|zone]]s.
** None from [[Exploration Mode]].
** 2 from bonus rounds: 1 from each of [[Cart]] and [[Robbers]].
** 1 from {{event|Cut ooze cake!}} in [[Ooze Kitchen]].
* Up to 18 can be earned per festival from the annual [[Super Adventure Box: Nostalgia]] achievements.
* There is no limit on how many can be acquired per day/festival from currency conversions.

== Trivia ==
* The name is a reference to [[w:Bubble Bobble|Bubble Bobble]].
